neper.notes: The baseline: the theme's own data grid. The sheets build their grids afresh per look, so the Windows look no longer leaks into the Neper passes (the earlier 1.5x Neper render showed the Windows grid).

windows.notes: Round 4 group e (fresh render, flat-pixel diff vs ref/windows and ref/windows/states at 100 %; 'flat' = reference pixels whose four neighbours are within 2 levels, so ClearType text and pictures are not in the numbers). data_grid_main (the pool grid with its group box, filter row and navigator over the collection grid): 1136 of 132614 flat px off by more than 2 (0.9 %), the backdrop picture band excluded (the whole sheet: 3590 of 135231). Geometry now exact to the pixel: 2 px frame, 19 px header over the filter row, 35 px group box, 4 px strip, 18 px group rows with their 2 px top lines, 19 px data rows with the 2 px foot lines, 2 px column lines, white indicator cells, 24 px footer with its lines, 23 px navigator with v3's button bitmaps and scroll thumb, the vertical bar (2 px thumb, content stops at the track). Bitmaps cut from the live capture: sort marks, expander box, filter funnel, equals mark, list glyph, star, row arrows, navigator buttons, header filter button. States: data_grid_states (top grid, 4th data row selected and focused, v3's dotted rectangle and long arrow): 2548 of 57344 flat px off; data_grid_states_pressed (Name header pressed, #BCDCF4): first 300 columns 2185 of 7200 px off by more than 2 (text included); data_grid_dialogs (Sort and Missing Set Cards grids, frameless, 18 and 19 px rows): 1432 of 56765 and 1346 of 29405 flat px off; data_grid_dialogs_sort (focused cell selection, the Sort dialog selects cells): 1432 of 56765. Captures: the navigator-button pressed grabs are identical to the navigator rest grab (v3 shows no pressed look there), and the unfocused selected-row grabs are identical to the focused ones (the posted kill-focus did not change them).
